lines.en: A winding path, curve after curve.
Scales rasp the grass.
I go around stones, not over them.
Every inch of travel costs nothing.
I work the forest's edge.
The body goes first, the head follows.
I press a line into the grass.
Slow, but never stopping.
I slip between the roots.
My thin shadow trails me.
Tongue out, tasting the air.
Coiled on a stone, sunning myself.
I'm almost still — only my tongue moves.
Sunlight warms me through the scales.
Listening to the grass.
I tighten my coils, loop by loop.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，又不动了。
lines.en: New pose, then still again.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在这个林子里很配。
lines.en: My pattern suits this forest.
I blink slowly.

lines.zh: 有人在附近踩断了枝条。
lines.en: Someone snapped a twig nearby.
The air's just the right warmth.
I lift my head for a look.

lines.zh: 不动的时候最难被看见。
lines.en: Stillness makes me invisible.
My belly rests on the stone.
Tongue out and in, quick.
Not planning to move today.
I coil a little tighter.
Wind passes over my scales.
Waiting for something small to pass.
I lift my head and look at you.
You're standing still. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的舌头能闻到你的热。
lines.en: My tongue tastes your warmth.
Don't step down. I won't bite.
I'm just sunning myself here.
You smell a little like rabbit.
I dislike having my tail grabbed.
Are you going to crouch down?

lines.zh: 我这一身花纹，不是吓你的。
lines.en: These patterns aren't a bluff.
Don't put your hand that close.
Looking at you like this is enough.
I curl into a tiny knot.
I pulled back half a foot.
A twinge runs through my body.
I give a thin hiss.
I can coil to protect myself.
I recover slowly.
Blood drips onto the stone.
I don't want to flee just yet.
Raw rabbit — is that for me?
Leave it. I'll come to it.

lines.zh: 那肉别晃，我舌头跟不上。
lines.en: Stop waving the meat—my tongue lags.
That's the right warmth.
I don't need much. A small piece.
Anything else in your hand?
I approach slowly.
It's still warm right now.
Two steps back and I'll eat.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住我尾巴了。
lines.en: Your boot is pressing on my tail.
I'm soft. I don't block the way.
Back off. I'm not coiled yet.

lines.zh: 平原的草里，我盘成一圈。
lines.en: In the plains grass, I coil in a ring.
I've slipped behind you.

lines.zh: 贴地的东西最容易被忽略。
lines.en: Low things are easiest to overlook.
I've looped around your boot tip.
Lift your foot and I'll move.
It's not the season for that.
I've always kept to myself.
I just want a warm stone.
I don't discuss that.
That's not how the forest works.
Wait until it truly warms up.
I turn away and coil up.
Don't joke about that.
It's warm. I like it.
Soft moss. Good bedding.
I swallowed it in one go.
Too big to hold.
I curl around it.
This has no smell.
I nudge it back where it was.
Picking it up is awkward.
You don't need to mind me at all.
Your steps are too heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，对着你的方向。
lines.en: Head up, facing your way.
I don't plan to move yet.
The grass moved. I saw.
I'm gathering my strength.
Grass too thick—only my path left.
I've already slipped around.

lines.zh: 兔子味，从那边飘过来了。
lines.en: Smell of rabbit, drifting over from that way.
I move when you turn.
I'm coming low along the ground.
I've coiled half a loop.
Where you stepped is still warm.
Counting your steps across the flat.
I'm very near your feet.
You've backed against the roots.
I'm trying to make no sound.
I strike at your leg.
I coil around you.
This one comes suddenly.
I've tightened a loop.
You can't shake me off at all.
Once I bite, I hold still.
Small fangs, but sharp.
Back off and I'll let go.
That was only self-defense.
I've already slid off.
This snake's pattern is fine.
The forest's warm. Perfect.
I slowly uncoil.
No other snakes around.
First, a warm stone.
The grass hides me.
I come out from under the leaves.
I slide into my own shadow.
I was never meant to be in water.
The blast threw me out of the grass.
That light froze my whole body.

lines.zh: 雷光让我的眼睛一片白。
lines.en: The flash left my eyes white.
Falling, my body still twisting.
